pairs.subject: data-retention
pairs.evidence: app/data/[token]/DataClient.tsx:122 The irreversible erasure request sends no target echo, so confirmation does not demonstrate comprehension of the specific target.

techniques.evidence: app/data/[token]/DataClient.tsx:318 The complete dialog offers Cancel and Confirm buttons without an echo field; the API accepts the token without reading or comparing an echoed identifier.
app/api/data/[token]/route.ts:86 This action erases a token-selected entry immediately; it accepts no configurable deletion window requiring a floor.

app/api/data/[token]/route.ts:43 The displayed inventory is a separate presence-based projection, not a preview mode of anonymizeEntry; it provides no shared scrub selection, preview timestamp, or per-store deletion yield.

app/api/data/[token]/route.ts:96 The route ignores calendar-removal outcomes and reports success even when a calendar copy remains; anonymizeEntry also logs recording-deletion failures without propagating them, contrary to the required degraded outcome for incomplete erasure.
app/data/[token]/DataClient.tsx:245 The page displays an existing consent-expiry date and requests targeted erasure; it neither configures nor resolves a tenant retention window.

app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts:2785 The invoked database scrub is an atomic operation for one entry, rather than a horizon-based purge of expired populations; the technique explicitly excludes operations requiring population-wide atomicity.
